newsitem.title: NORWAY: U.S. Sonat buys 94 pct in Norway's Transocean.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Sonat buys 94 pct in Norway's Transocean.

text.p: U.S. company Sonat Offshore Drilling Inc said on Wednesday it had purchased around 50.9 million shares in Norwegian drilling and offshore services group Transocean ASA.
The stock represented around 94 percent of the outstanding shares in Transocean following the expiry of Sonat's exchange offer, according to a statement from the Oslo bourse.
Sonat said it intended to commence a mandatory offer for the remaining shares in accordance with Norwegian securities regulations.

"Pursuant to the terms of the exchange offer, Sonat Offshore will issue a total of approximately 22.9 million shares of Sonat Offshore common stock and approximately $207 million in cash in consideration of the tendered Transocean shares," the statement said.
The new merged company will be called Transocean Offshore Inc, which will take effect from September 4.
